	round = yes
	multiply = 10
	add = 1
}

# Pairwise score differences and per-right ranks (0 = best) for the tooltip
# ranking. On a tied score the earlier right in the priority order ranks higher.
cm_trmm_diff_tooling__jewelry = {
	value = cm_trmm_right_tooling
	subtract = cm_trmm_right_jewelry
}

	value = 0

		limit = { cm_trmm_diff_tooling__jewelry < 0 }
		add = 1

		limit = { cm_trmm_diff_tooling__naval < 0 }
		add = 1

		limit = { cm_trmm_diff_tooling__textile < 0 }

		add = 1
	}

		add = 1
	}
}

# Tie-aware dense tier for the search mode tooltips: is_leader marks the
# earliest-priority right at each distinct score, tier counts distinct scores
# strictly above (0 = best, so tierdisp is 1-based), tier_total is the number
# of distinct scores at this location, and tie_count is how many other rights
# share this exact score.
cm_trmm_is_leader_tooling = {
	value = 1
}
cm_trmm_is_leader_jewelry = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				cm_trmm_diff_tooling__jewelry = 0
			}
		}
		value = 0
	}
}
cm_trmm_is_leader_naval = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				cm_trmm_diff_tooling__naval = 0
				cm_trmm_diff_jewelry__naval = 0
			}
		}
		value = 0
	}
}
cm_trmm_is_leader_textile = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				cm_trmm_diff_tooling__textile = 0
				cm_trmm_diff_jewelry__textile = 0
				cm_trmm_diff_naval__textile = 0
			}
		}
		value = 0
	}
}
cm_trmm_is_leader_weaponry = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				cm_trmm_diff_tooling__weaponry = 0
				cm_trmm_diff_jewelry__weaponry = 0
				cm_trmm_diff_naval__weaponry = 0
				cm_trmm_diff_textile__weaponry = 0
			}
		}
		value = 0
	}
}
cm_trmm_is_leader_book = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				cm_trmm_diff_tooling__book = 0
				cm_trmm_diff_jewelry__book = 0
				cm_trmm_diff_naval__book = 0
				cm_trmm_diff_textile__book = 0
				cm_trmm_diff_weaponry__book = 0
			}
		}
		value = 0
	}
}
cm_trmm_is_leader_artisan = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				cm_trmm_diff_tooling__artisan = 0
				cm_trmm_diff_jewelry__artisan = 0
				cm_trmm_diff_naval__artisan = 0
				cm_trmm_diff_textile__artisan = 0
				cm_trmm_diff_weaponry__artisan = 0
				cm_trmm_diff_book__artisan = 0
			}
		}
		value = 0
	}
}
cm_trmm_is_leader_brewing = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				cm_trmm_diff_tooling__brewing = 0
				cm_trmm_diff_jewelry__brewing = 0
				cm_trmm_diff_naval__brewing = 0
				cm_trmm_diff_textile__brewing = 0
				cm_trmm_diff_weaponry__brewing = 0
				cm_trmm_diff_book__brewing = 0
				cm_trmm_diff_artisan__brewing = 0
			}
		}
		value = 0
	}

cm_trmm_is_leader_masonry = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				cm_trmm_diff_tooling__masonry = 0
				cm_trmm_diff_jewelry__masonry = 0

			}
		}
		value = 0
	}
}

cm_trmm_tier_tooling = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			cm_trmm_is_leader_jewelry = 1
			cm_trmm_diff_tooling__jewelry < 0
		}
		add = 1
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			cm_trmm_is_leader_naval = 1
			cm_trmm_diff_tooling__naval < 0
		}
		add = 1
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			cm_trmm_is_leader_textile = 1
			cm_trmm_diff_tooling__textile < 0
		}
		add = 1
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			cm_trmm_is_leader_weaponry = 1
			cm_trmm_diff_tooling__weaponry < 0
		}
		add = 1
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			cm_trmm_is_leader_book = 1
			cm_trmm_diff_tooling__book < 0
		}
		add = 1
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			cm_trmm_is_leader_artisan = 1
			cm_trmm_diff_tooling__artisan < 0
		}
		add = 1
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			cm_trmm_is_leader_brewing = 1
			cm_trmm_diff_tooling__brewing < 0
		}
		add = 1
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			cm_trmm_is_leader_masonry = 1
			cm_trmm_diff_tooling__masonry < 0
		}
		add = 1
	}
}

	value = cm_trmm_tier_tooling
	add = 1
}

		limit = { cm_trmm_ind_diff_books__masonry >= 0 }
		add = 1
	}
	if = {
		limit = { cm_trmm_ind_diff_furniture__masonry >= 0 }
		add = 1
	}
	if = {
		limit = { cm_trmm_ind_diff_pottery__masonry >= 0 }
		add = 1
	}
	if = {
		limit = { cm_trmm_ind_diff_leather__masonry >= 0 }
		add = 1
	}
	if = {
		limit = { cm_trmm_ind_diff_liquor__masonry >= 0 }
		add = 1
	}
	if = {
		limit = { cm_trmm_ind_diff_beer__masonry >= 0 }
		add = 1
	}
	if = {
		limit = { cm_trmm_ind_diff_wine__masonry >= 0 }
		add = 1
	}
	if = {
		limit = { cm_trmm_ind_diff_masonry__glass < 0 }
		add = 1
	}
}

# Count of royal specialization rights granted at this location. Read live
# by the build-location urban-right marker to pick its display state.
cm_uright_assigned_count = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_tooling_rights }
		add = 1
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_jewelry_rights }
		add = 1
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_naval_rights }
		add = 1
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_textile_rights }
		add = 1
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_weaponry_rights }
		add = 1
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_book_rights }
		add = 1
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_artisan_rights }
		add = 1
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_brewing_rights }
		add = 1
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_masonry_rights }
		add = 1
	}
}

# 1 when any urban right both scores and is ungranted here (the
# grant row's best-mode gate). Root is the location.
cm_trmm_grant_choices = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = cm_trmm_best_idx
			OR = {
				AND = {
					cm_trmm_right_tooling > 0
					NOT = { has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_tooling_rights }
				}
				AND = {
					cm_trmm_right_jewelry > 0
					NOT = { has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_jewelry_rights }
				}
				AND = {
					cm_trmm_right_naval > 0
					NOT = { has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_naval_rights }
				}
				AND = {
					cm_trmm_right_textile > 0
					NOT = { has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_textile_rights }
				}
				AND = {
					cm_trmm_right_weaponry > 0
					NOT = { has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_weaponry_rights }
				}
				AND = {
					cm_trmm_right_book > 0
					NOT = { has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_book_rights }
				}
				AND = {
					cm_trmm_right_artisan > 0
					NOT = { has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_artisan_rights }
				}
				AND = {
					cm_trmm_right_brewing > 0
					NOT = { has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_brewing_rights }
				}
				AND = {
					cm_trmm_right_masonry > 0
					NOT = { has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_masonry_rights }
				}
			}
		}
		add = 1
	}
}
